coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, converted from the epsilon limit via Eq.(3c) assuming B0_rms = 1 nG (epsilon = g_agamma*B/(1e-10 GeV^-1 nG))
notes: Paper revisits constraints on resonant axion-photon conversion from CMB spectral distortions (COBE/FIRAS reanalysis + CosmoTherm). This is an AxionPhoton (g_agamma) bound, NOT dark photon (the dark photon case is their companion work). Primary result plotted as epsilon vs m_a (Fig.11) and g_agamma vs m_a (Fig.13) over ma ~ 1e-13 to 1e-4 eV. The FIRAS constraint is roughly mass-independent in the mu/y era at epsilon ~ few x 1e-2 (they use epsilon~4e-2 as 'a bit above the FIRAS limit'). Converting to g_agamma requires an assumed primordial B-field; I used B0_rms = 1 nG (their quoted Planck upper bound) giving g_agamma ~ 3e-12 GeV^-1. Values are approximate plot/text reads, and scale linearly with B. Limits weaken (rise) at low mass with edges/features below ~1e-11 eV. PIXIE forecast ~2 orders of magnitude better. 95% c.l. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.4, 4))
